solver_time_averaging.how: Compared probe scripts differing only by SOLVER_TIME_AVERAGING before/after INITIALIZE_SOLVER and counted their outputs; wall seconds (126 control, 300 killed mutant) are transcribed from the supplied probe measurement because the folders contain no wall-time receipt.
solver_time_averaging.remedy: The package refuses the pproc [time_averaging] key at plan on a build where SOLVER_TIME_AVERAGING is not verified.

vtk_export.how: Compared ASCII POLYDATA coordinates, polygons and scalar payload lengths with their headers and Boundary_Index surface connectivity.

csv_export.how: Compared CSV rows with native-log sector vertices and VTK surface points with those rows times the script's periodic-copy count (CSV is one sector; VTK includes all copies).

niter_limit.how: Compared counted inner iterations with each row's recorded NITER and export total: 2502 has 5..5 on 36 steps (total 180), so NITER bounds each time step; 2503 has 6..90 (median 32.5, total 1100, NITER 300), so convergence_iterations=3 is not a cap.

per_step_exports.how: Compared nonempty stamped files and every step with the range and export templates recorded in the per-step action program.
